You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0234.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
# atoms coordinates in drawing (x, -y)
coords={
'A':(420,-223),'B':(520,-165),'T':(520,-46),'C':(625,-223),'Ocarbon1':(700,-180),
'D':(625,-342),'MeD':(700,-313),'Cester':(715,-425),'Ocarbon2':(790,-395),'Oester':(667,-541),
'E':(520,-402),'Obridge':(420,-345),'F':(548,-520),'N':(429,-520),
'Q':(333,-451),'R':(234,-516),'S':(137,-428),'P':(212,-343),'U':(212,-222),'V':(320,-165),
'MeV':(320,-90),'MeP':(100,-282),
'J':(608,-625),'K':(548,-729),'MeK':(585,-785),'L':(429,-729),'M':(369,-625),
'Ca':(389,-797),'Oa':(326,-837),'Oa2':(411,-843),
}
# Wait acid group drawn HO2C text: encode anyway coords arbitrary. Ensure acid C connected L; Oa carbonyl, Oa2 OH.
RWM=Chem.RWMol(); idx={}
elems={'Ocarbon1':'O','Ocarbon2':'O','Oester':'O','Obridge':'O','Oa':'O','Oa2':'O', 'C':'C','Cester':'C','Ca':'C'}
for name in coords:
    a=Chem.Atom(elems.get(name, 'C'))
    idx[name]=RWM.AddAtom(a)

def bond(a,b,typ=Chem.BondType.SINGLE, stereo=None):
    RWM.AddBond(idx[a],idx[b],typ)
    if stereo:
        bo=RWM.GetBondBetweenAtoms(idx[a],idx[b])
        bo.SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE if stereo=='wedge' else Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
# graph
bond('A','B'); bond('B','T',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('B','C'); bond('C','Ocarbon1',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('C','D')
bond('D','E'); bond('D','MeD',stereo='wedge'); bond('D','Cester'); bond('Cester','Ocarbon2',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('Cester','Oester'); bond('Oester','F',stereo='wedge')
bond('E','Obridge',stereo='dash'); bond('Obridge','A',stereo='dash'); bond('E','F'); bond('F','N'); bond('N','Q',stereo='dash'); bond('Q','R'); bond('R','S'); bond('S','P'); bond('P','U'); bond('U','V'); bond('V','A'); bond('V','MeV',stereo='wedge'); bond('P','MeP',stereo='dash')
bond('N','M'); bond('M','L',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('L','K'); bond('K','J'); bond('J','F'); bond('K','MeK',stereo='dash'); bond('L','Ca'); bond('Ca','Oa',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('Ca','Oa2')
m=RWM.GetMol()
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for name,i in idx.items():
    x,y=coords[name]; conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x/100, y/100,0.0))
m.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,0,True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('centers:')
for name,i in idx.items():
    a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i)
    if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') or a.GetChiralTag()!=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED:
        print(name, a.GetChiralTag(), a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else None)
print('smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
# add H and embed
mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=234; params.maxIterations=1000; params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True; params.useMacrocycle14config=True
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,params)
print('embed',res)
if res<0:
    for seed in range(4,30):
        params.randomSeed=seed
        res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,params)
        if res==0: break
print('embed retry',res)
if res==0:
    # optimize
    print('mmff', AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=1000))
    # xyz
    conf=mh.GetConformer()
    with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
        f.write(f'{mh.GetNumAtoms()}\n3D structure generated from mol_0234.png\n')
        for i,a in enumerate(mh.GetAtoms()):
            p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
            f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
    print('wrote',mh.GetNumAtoms())

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

rw=Chem.RWMol()
coords={}

def atom(name,el,x=None,y=None):
    a=Chem.Atom(el); idx=rw.AddAtom(a)
    if x is not None: coords[name]=(float(x),float(-y)) # y up
    names[name]=idx
    return idx
names={}
# core carbon framework image coordinates
pos={
'A':(361,827),'B':(361,709),'C':(464,649),'D':(563,709),'E':(563,826),'F':(464,885),
'G':(671,648),'H':(779,709),'I':(779,826),'J':(671,890),
'K':(671,531),'L':(774,470),'M':(878,531),'N':(878,648),
'P':(982,470),'Q':(1086,531),'R':(1086,648),'S':(982,709),
'T':(982,351),'U':(1086,291),'V':(1188,351),'W':(1188,469),
'MeD':(563,590),'MeH':(774,590),'MeN':(878,765),'MeF':(489,1000),
'X':(878,291),'MeX1':(774,351),'MeX2':(878,172),
'OAcO':(286,867),'OAcC':(224,830),'OAcOd':(224,765),'OAcMe':(165,830),
'COOMeC':(1188,590),'COOMeOd':(1250,560),'COOMeOs':(1235,650),'COOMeMe':(1300,680),
'OUd':(1086,218),'OWd':(1260,469),
'HF':(427,992),'HE':(563,942),'HG':(671,766),'HM':(878,454)
}
for n, (x,y) in pos.items(): atom(n,'O' if n in ['OAcO','OAcOd','COOMeOd','COOMeOs','OUd','OWd','V'] else ('H' if n in ['HF','HE','HG','HM'] else 'C'),x,y)

def bond(a,b,order=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(names[a],names[b],order)
# ring cycles
for cyc in [('A','B','C','D','E','F'),('D','G','H','I','J','E'),('G','K','L','M','N','H'),('M','P','Q','R','S','N'),('P','T','U','V','W','Q')]:
    for a,b in zip(cyc,cyc[1:]+cyc[:1]):
        # make P=T double; carbonyl bonds later
        if set((a,b))==set(('P','T')): bond(a,b,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
        elif set((a,b)) in [set(('U','V')),set(('V','W'))]: bond(a,b)
        else: bond(a,b)
# ring double carbonyls
bond('U','OUd',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('W','OWd',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
# substituent branches
for a,b in [('D','MeD'),('H','MeH'),('N','MeN'),('F','MeF'),('T','X'),('X','MeX1'),('X','MeX2')]: bond(a,b)
# OAc A-O-C(=O)-Me
bond('A','OAcO'); bond('OAcO','OAcC'); bond('OAcC','OAcOd',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('OAcC','OAcMe')
# methoxycarbonyl at Q
bond('Q','COOMeC'); bond('COOMeC','COOMeOd',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('COOMeC','COOMeOs'); bond('COOMeOs','COOMeMe')
# explicit stereochemical hydrogens shown
for c,h in [('F','HF'),('E','HE'),('G','HG'),('M','HM')]: bond(c,h)

mol=rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(mol)
# Draw stereo centers with wedge ligand sign: + toward viewer, - away
wedges={
'A':('OAcO',+1), 'F':('MeF',+1), # F also H dashed
'D':('MeD',+1), 'E':('HE',-1), 'G':('HG',-1), 'H':('MeH',+1),
'M':('HM',+1), 'N':('MeN',-1), 'Q':('COOMeC',+1)
}
# include F dashed H and only selected bond is first wedge; assign individual vector z separately
bondz={('A','OAcO'):1,('F','MeF'):1,('F','HF'):-1,('D','MeD'):1,('E','HE'):-1,('G','HG'):-1,('H','MeH'):1,('M','HM'):1,('N','MeN'):-1,('Q','COOMeC'):1}
# priority ranks
mH=Chem.AddHs(mol)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mH,cleanIt=True,force=True)
# Atom indices match original + added H; identify added implicit hydrogen on A
# vectors per local center
center_names=list(wedges)
for c in center_names:
    ci=names[c]; atomc=mH.GetAtomWithIdx(ci)
    neigh=[]
    for nb in atomc.GetNeighbors():
        ni=nb.GetIdx()
        # name lookup
        nm=next((k for k,v in names.items() if v==ni),None)
        if nm is None: nm='ADDED_H'
        if nm=='ADDED_H':
            # infer missing hydrogen projection opposite sum of heavy/drawn ligand xy vectors
            others=[]
            for n2 in atomc.GetNeighbors():
                if n2.GetIdx()==ni: continue
                nm2=next((k for k,v in names.items() if v==n2.GetIdx()),None)
                if nm2 is None: continue
                x0,y0=coords[c]; x1,y1=coords[nm2]
                others.append(np.array([x1-x0,y1-y0,0.]))
            vv=-np.sum(others,axis=0)
            # if tiny set arbitrary
            if np.linalg.norm(vv[:2])<1e-5: vv=np.array([0.,1.,0.])
        else:
            x0,y0=coords[c]; x1,y1=coords[nm]
            z=bondz.get((c,nm),bondz.get((nm,c),0))
            vv=np.array([x1-x0,y1-y0,float(z)])
        rank=int(nb.GetProp('_CIPRank')) if nb.HasProp('_CIPRank') else -1
        neigh.append((rank,nm,vv))
    # highest rank = priority one
    neigh.sort(reverse=True,key=lambda z:z[0])
    if len(neigh)!=4:
        raise RuntimeError((c,[(n[1],n[0]) for n in neigh]))
    v1,v2,v3,v4=[x[2] for x in neigh]
    det=np.linalg.det(np.stack([v1-v4,v2-v4,v3-v4],axis=1))
    target='R' if det<0 else 'S'
    print(c, 'prio',[(n,r) for r,n,v in neigh], 'det',det,'=>',target)
    atomc.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW)
    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mH,cleanIt=True,force=True)
    got=atomc.GetProp('_CIPCode') if atomc.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?'
    if got!=target:
        atomc.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW)
        Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mH,cleanIt=True,force=True)
        got=atomc.GetProp('_CIPCode') if atomc.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?'
    if got!=target: raise RuntimeError((c,target,got))
    print('  RDKit',got)
# make sure stereo labels
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mH,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(mH)))
# embed and optimize
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=231; params.useSmallRingTorsions=True; params.maxIterations=1000
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mH,params)
print('embed',res,'atoms',mH.GetNumAtoms())
if res<0:
    raise SystemExit('embedding failed')
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mH)
if props:
    ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mH,props)
    print('MMFF initial',ff.CalcEnergy())
    ff.Minimize(maxIts=2000)
    print('MMFF end',ff.CalcEnergy())
# output xyz
conf=mH.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{mH.GetNumAtoms()}\n')
    f.write('3D structure generated from mol_0231.png\n')
    for i,a in enumerate(mH.GetAtoms()):
        p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
        f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
print('wrote answer.xyz')

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDescriptors
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
coords={
'A':(420,-223),'B':(520,-165),'T':(520,-46),'C':(625,-223),'Oc1':(700,-180),
'D':(625,-342),'MeD':(700,-313),'Cester':(715,-425),'Oc2':(790,-395),'Oester':(667,-541),
'E':(520,-402),'Obridge':(420,-345),'F':(548,-520),'N':(429,-520),
'Q':(333,-451),'R':(234,-516),'S':(137,-428),'P':(212,-343),'U':(212,-222),'V':(320,-165),
'MeV':(320,-90),'MeP':(100,-282),
'J':(608,-625),'K':(548,-729),'MeK':(585,-785),'L':(429,-729),'M':(369,-625),
'Ca':(389,-797),'Oa':(326,-837),'Oa2':(411,-843),
}
els={n:'O' for n in ('Oc1','Oc2','Oester','Obridge','Oa','Oa2')}
rw=Chem.RWMol(); idx={}
for name in coords:
    idx[name]=rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(els.get(name,'C')))
def bond(a,b,typ=Chem.BondType.SINGLE,stereo=None):
    rw.AddBond(idx[a],idx[b],typ)
    if stereo:
        rw.GetBondBetweenAtoms(idx[a],idx[b]).SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE if stereo=='wedge' else Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
# Top unsaturated enone and fused lactone
bond('A','B'); bond('B','T',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('B','C'); bond('C','Oc1',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('C','D')
bond('D','E'); bond('D','MeD',stereo='wedge'); bond('D','Cester'); bond('Cester','Oc2',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('Cester','Oester'); bond('F','Oester',stereo='wedge')
bond('E','Obridge',stereo='dash'); bond('A','Obridge',stereo='dash'); bond('E','F')
# Macrocycle left side
bond('F','N'); bond('N','Q',stereo='dash'); bond('Q','R'); bond('R','S'); bond('S','P'); bond('P','U'); bond('U','V'); bond('V','A')
bond('V','MeV',stereo='wedge'); bond('P','MeP',stereo='dash')
# Cyclohexene ring
bond('N','M'); bond('M','L',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('L','K'); bond('K','J'); bond('J','F'); bond('K','MeK',stereo='dash')
# Carboxylic acid substituent
bond('L','Ca'); bond('Ca','Oa',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('Ca','Oa2')
m=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
cf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for n,i in idx.items():
    x,y=coords[n]; cf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x/100,y/100,0.0))
m.AddConformer(cf)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,0,True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('Formula:',rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m),'heavy atoms:',m.GetNumAtoms())
print('Stereo centers:',[(n,m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetProp('_CIPCode')) for n,i in idx.items() if m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).HasProp('_CIPCode')])
mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=234; params.maxIterations=1000; params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True; params.useMacrocycle14config=True
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,params)
print('Embed:',res,'total atoms:',mh.GetNumAtoms())
if res<0:
    for seed in range(1,20):
        params.randomSeed=seed
        res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,params)
        if res==0: break
if res<0: raise RuntimeError('3D embedding failed')
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mh)
if props:
    ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mh,props)
    ff.Minimize(maxIts=1500)
    print('MMFF energy:',ff.CalcEnergy())
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mh,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('Final stereo:',[(n,mh.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetProp('_CIPCode')) for n,i in idx.items() if mh.GetAtomWithIdx(i).HasProp('_CIPCode')])
conf=mh.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{mh.GetNumAtoms()}\n3D structure generated from mol_0234.png\n')
    for i,a in enumerate(mh.GetAtoms()):
        p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
        f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
print('Wrote answer.xyz')
